$comment: The Realistic world (docs/proposals/REALISTIC_WORLD.md, phase R2; owner 2026-11-11: "the seed should determine tectonic plates, rain shadow, ground/rock materials, etc."): the seed does the placing. `tectonics.plates` 1: each face's own plate layout from its face seed (shared/worldgen/plates.json) decides land and sea (continental plates land, oceanic sea, a sea margin at the disc's edge), and every boundary adds its kind's landform by rule (ranges on a subducting boundary's overriding side with a trench before them, collision ranges where two continents meet, rifts on divergent boundaries, little on transforms), with arcs of dormant cones on the overriding side and hotspot chains older along the plate's motion (plates.json `uplift`). No hand-placed boundary, arc or chain. Climate (R3), biomes by climate (R4) and rocks from plate history (R5) come later; until then the default biome and the noise's rock provinces. A test world, not in the New world form yet (R6: `newWorld`); its seeds' terrain may change between releases while it is one (owner, §7 q7). Play it at ?worldgen=test:realistic. Prototype content.
name: test:realistic
